intentionalAdaptations: Run the supported CRUD/filter/count subset against the Convex component and an independent deterministic in-memory reference model; joins, numeric IDs, UUID IDs, offsets, and transactions are intentionally unsupported.
Exercise Better Auth factory transformation separately for forceAllowId and logical-to-physical field names before the component boundary.
Extend the upstream increment contract with Convex-specific concurrent decrement, overflow, set-overlap, return-value, trigger, and transaction-rollback proofs.

Require public count to delegate once to the component's single-snapshot count query, require count and fully paginated findMany to select the same rows, and reject atomic bulk/relationship plans above the reviewed 128-row transaction budget before any write or trigger effect.

records.modificationSummary: Reworked the adapter factory around logical IDs, indexed relationships, atomic component writes, single-snapshot counts, and fail-closed provider ID-token encryption. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension carries request-local rotation-parent and consent identity into component writes, binds refresh reads to the presented client, and reports retryable concurrent rotation without exposing token material.

Rebuilt component functions with strict validation, indexed relationships, failure-atomic writes and triggers, single-snapshot counts, one atomic rate-limit consume operation, guarded consumption and increments, authenticated signing-key rotation, component-owned session-generation invalidation and admission, and scheduled physical session expiry. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension admits refresh reads and writes against current canonical authority, bounds child expiry by the original session and parent, and revokes consent for provider family invalidation while limiting physical refresh-history cleanup. The 2026-09-26 Better Auth 1.7.6 alignment selects provider refresh families through the generated (clientId, userId) index. The 2026-09-26 auth-ergonomics pass skips retired signing keys with unreadable creation times during rotation, refuses to report a malformed current key as ready, and adds bounded idempotent pruning of retired keys past the verification grace. The same pass makes ensure validate every current key, including its versioned encrypted private key, with the signer's own rules so ensure never reports ready while signing would fail closed. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass adds the component-only oauthLiveAccess query, which checks session admission, client, resource, client-resource link, and consent for one OAuth grant in a single transaction.

Extracted one precomputed, cycle-safe relationship engine for indexed parent validation and table-qualified atomic cascade, restrict, and set-null planning. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension permits session, user, and client deletion without traversing unbounded refresh history; retained rows lose authority through live admission, while creation and reference-changing writes still require valid parents.

Rewrote deterministic schema and metadata generation for logical IDs, canonical nullability, reserved session-generation fields, explicit supported deletion policies, indexed relationship lookups, collision-safe adapter indexes, and a stable model fingerprint. The 2026-09-15 renewal extension reserves bcnConsentId on refresh rows and marks this immutable grant binding as unavailable to caller input and updates. The 2026-09-26 Better Auth 1.7.6 alignment declares the unique (providerId, accountId) account identity and the (clientId, userId) refresh-family index. The 2026-09-27 upgrade pass keeps the retired Better Auth 1.7.0-1.7.2 account issuer as an optional, unindexed schema-only column (outside adapter metadata, never written or read) so 1.0.0-beta account rows still validate on schema push, and fails generation if Better Auth defines that column again. The 2026-09-27 refresh-token upgrade fix renders the component-owned bcnConsentId refresh-row field as an optional Convex column marked optional in metadata, so 1.0.0-beta refresh tokens (which lack it) no longer block the schema push; the adapter still writes it on every new row.

New 2026-09-27 upgrade check: a paginated walk of the (providerId, accountId) index through the public findMany query that reports 1.0.0-beta account rows sharing one key, and fails closed on stalled cursors, malformed rows, forged resume cursors, or rows out of index order. Each call reads at most maxPages pages (1-1000, default 100) of at most pageSize rows (1-100) and returns an opaque continueCursor that carries the open key's rows, so a large table is checked across several calls without splitting a collision.

Split logical-to-physical field and executable relationship metadata into one typed contract shared by generation and adapter operations, with one fail-closed mismatch result for malformed or divergent schemas. The 2026-09-27 upgrade pass adds per-model legacy columns that must be optional in the Convex schema and are excluded from every adapter field lookup. The refresh-token upgrade fix adds an optional-column flag for component-owned fields added after the betas and requires the exported schema field to be optional exactly when the metadata says so.

Rebuilt filtering, capped and cap-free atomic collection, bounded-memory count paging, index selection, sorting, and cursor pagination around fail-closed logical-field semantics and explicit unsupported-query rejection.

Added component-owned user and session generations so the provider's canonical delete-all selector atomically invalidates every earlier session without an unbounded collection scan; stale sessions fail adapter reads and backend admission until scheduled physical expiry. Owns the internal component admission read that requires an unexpired session whose generation matches its user.
Regenerated the component API declarations from the Better Convex Nuxt component.

Regenerated the public ComponentApi declaration including relationship-aware writes, atomic rate-limit consumption, guarded consumption and increments, signing-key lifecycle operations, and persisted-session admission. Regenerated on 2026-09-15 for the optional oauthRefreshParentId create argument and oauthRefreshGrantId family-deletion argument. Regenerated on 2026-09-26 for the bounded pruneSigningKeys operation. Regenerated on 2026-09-26 for the oauthLiveAccess query. Regenerated on 2026-09-27 because the oauthLiveAccess query requires grantId.
Regenerated the component data-model declarations from the curated core schema.
Regenerated the component server declarations from the Better Convex Nuxt component.

Reduced the component adapter to a thin assembly of the shared adapter functions, including persisted-session admission, scheduled session expiry, atomic rate-limit consumption, and atomic signing-key rotation. The 2026-09-26 pass exports bounded retired signing-key pruning. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass exports the single-transaction oauthLiveAccess query.
Rewrote the fixed component definition for the curated Better Convex Nuxt schema and functions.

Generated adapter metadata with required session-generation fields and explicit indexed relationship and deletion policies for the exact stable Better Auth 1.7.6 (providerId, accountId) account identity, OAuth provider, JWKS, and database rate-limit schema, including the reserved, non-updatable bcnConsentId refresh-row field, the (clientId, userId) refresh-family index, the retired account issuer declared as a legacy column outside adapter fields, and the resulting canonical fingerprint. The refresh-token upgrade fix marks bcnConsentId optional so beta refresh rows without it validate.
Rewrote one deterministic greenfield Better Auth, JWT, OAuth, and database rate-limit schema profile.

Regenerated the fresh-install component schema and relationship indexes from the fixed Better Auth 1.7.6 profile, including the unique (providerId, accountId) account identity, session-generation authority, OAuth application metadata fields, the nullable bcnConsentId refresh-row field for immutable consent binding, the (clientId, userId) refresh-family index, and the retired account issuer as an optional column so 1.0.0-beta account rows still validate. The refresh-token upgrade fix makes bcnConsentId an optional nullable column so 1.0.0-beta refresh rows without it validate on push.
Retained only the context types and writable-context guard required by the integrated adapter. The 2026-09-26 pass keeps the writable-context guard internal to the factory.

Reduced the component client to one maintained adapter and route surface with component-owned persisted-session admission, provider-owned OAuth access revalidation, signed proxy-IP resolution, final-session validation, and authenticated JWKS rotation. The 2026-09-26 pass makes the component internal to the factory, adds the pruneSigningKeys operator, and routes configuration failures through sanitized diagnostics. It also adds sessionHttpAction, which runs an application HTTP action behind the same signed client-IP, public-origin, same-origin, Better Auth rate-limited get-session, and generation-fenced admission checks as the auth routes. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate pass removes the internal validateOAuthAccess wrapper; live OAuth checks run only through the MCP verifier and requireMcpPrincipal.

Introduced one reviewed factory that owns adapter wiring, JWT and plugin ordering, route registration, keys, secrets, projections, OAuth operations, and atomic database rate-limit storage; admits fail-closed request-scoped email and user-creation policy, keeps arbitrary plugins limited to the internal loopback-only test constructor, and lets that constructor revalidate its boundary for every auth instance. The 2026-09-26 auth-ergonomics pass makes the factory the only composition path; adds revocation- and generation-aware getUser/requireUser and the hardened sessionHttpAction; bounds session policy (including a five-minute, non-refreshing cookie cache) and trusted linking providers; makes password reset an explicit opt-in; signs bounded default profile claims; replaces per-callback email options with one typed writable-context email hook whose failures are logged sanitized and replaced by a static error before Better Auth sees them; rejects unknown options; and logs sanitized configuration sub-codes behind the opaque public error. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass adds the strict oauth.mcp provider profile, the component-key MCP access verifier, requireMcpPrincipal, and the per-user oauthConnections list and revoke helpers. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate pass removes auth.validateOAuthAccess and the default profile session claims; profile claims are opt-in through defineSessionClaims.

Added server-side diagnostics for the opaque AUTH_CONFIG_INVALID and handler failures: one stable sub-code per failure point and a redacted, length-bounded cause in the server log, while public errors and response bodies stay the bare code. The 2026-09-26 pass adds AUTH_EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED logging with the message type and a cause stripped of the message credentials before generic redaction.

Replaced the compatibility barrel with the fixed narrow Better Convex Nuxt API, including the reviewed auth factory, maintained component, atomic rate-limit storage constructor, provider, Better Auth MCP access verifier and OAuth operator, and rebuildable user projection. The 2026-09-15 public type surface also exports OAuthLiveAccess for the application live-authority callback. The 2026-09-26 pass removes the manual composition exports (convexAuth, createAuthComponent, rate-limit storage, writable-context guard) so the factory is the only composition path, and exports the typed email, session-policy, session HTTP action, account, and user types. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass exports the MCP principal validator and the MCP profile, principal, verifier, and connection types. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate pass exports the team-organization auth instance type named by the public factory overload. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate review removes the createBetterAuthMcpAccessVerifier and OAuthLiveAccess exports, so auth.createMcpAccessVerifier and auth.requireMcpPrincipal are the only public OAuth access checks. The 2026-09-27 upgrade pass exports findAccountKeyCollisions and its report types, a read-only scan for beta account rows that share a (providerId, accountId) key.
Replaced inferred and forwarded origins with strict SITE_URL and CONVEX_SITE_URL lookup through the shared parser.

Added one package-owned Better Auth custom storage boundary that delegates the complete rate-limit decision and counter update to one atomic component mutation and retries only exact final uncommitted Convex contention from an action context with a fixed bound.

Rewrote the Convex plugin as the composition, request-guard, and session-issuance owner; exact OAuth Provider compatibility, package-owned atomic rate-limit storage, and operator calls live behind fail-closed guards. The 2026-09-15 extension admits the explicit renewable profile in bounded token and revocation guards and projects its refresh grant in authorization-server metadata. The 2026-09-26 alignment mirrors the pinned 1.7.6 provider's HTTP loopback redirect matching, including localhost port variance. The 2026-09-26 pass reserves sid and token_use against custom claims, rejects non-object claim output, reads JWKS through the malformed-row-tolerant selector, and returns a no-store coded 500 when JWKS is unavailable. The 2026-09-27 pass only rewords the reserved-claim comment after default profile claims were removed.
Isolated the upstream bearer-assisted session-token flow behind one fixed in-process header that both public HTTP boundaries strip before dispatch.

Replaced public lazy key creation and destructive rollover with pinned Better Auth RS256 generation, encrypted-private and public-only JWK validation, authenticated atomic winner initialization, additive rotation, and bounded grace-period retention. The 2026-09-26 pass skips malformed retired keys with a bounded, key-material-free log, fails closed on a malformed current key, and adds bounded prune eligibility past the verification grace. Current-key document checks also require the versioned encrypted private key, matching the signer.

Added one request-scoped operator for preregistered public OAuth clients with asynchronously resolved admitted scopes, safe redirect schemes, explicit application-owned resources, fixed provider security fields, deterministic rollback of partial writes, and no user-session dependency. The 2026-09-15 extension admits resource scope supersets, creates resources from the canonical profile scope set, and enables client refresh grants only when offline_access was admitted. The 2026-09-26 pass reports operator configuration failures through sanitized diagnostics. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass adds host client presets bound to the MCP resource and client disabling.

Added provider security and token invariants behind a local structural profile that does not expose provider-private types: mandatory fail-closed privilege callbacks, bounded request parsing, canonical exact HTTPS or HTTP-loopback redirects, token-method client classification, stable application-type validation, opaque join-row identity with compound client/resource binding, S256 PKCE, projected metadata, access-token claim validation, and the documented time-bounded URL.canParse capability fill. The 2026-09-15 extension validates the fixed seven-day renewal and ten-second retry profile, reserves and verifies the immutable bcn_grant_id claim, and advertises refresh only for that profile. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate review issues and requires bcn_grant_id on every access token, renewable or not.

Isolated the exact-version Better Auth OAuth Provider compatibility firewall: scoped Lupinum plugin identity and order, installed callback identity, disabled upstream routes, fixed JWT/JWKS and storage profile, production proxy requirement, stable application-type projection, retired-field rejection, and safe administrator client/resource mutations. The 2026-09-15 extension requires the package-owned adapter for renewal and validates the exact installed grant list, refresh lifetime, and retry interval against the configured profile.

Replaced upstream type inference with one internal fixed GET action for the maintained same-origin Convex session-token route. The 2026-09-26 auth-ergonomics pass adds an optional request observer fetch plugin so session reconciliation sees every Better Auth request path, not only `$sessionSignal`.

Added bounded compact-JWT and canonical-JWKS validation around pinned-provider JOSE verification, with HTTPS-only production endpoints and exact loopback HTTP development endpoints, followed by exact issuer, audience, client, subject, scope, session, and token-class binding. The 2026-09-15 extension passes the verified immutable grant identity into live-access validation. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass verifies MCP access tokens against public RS256 keys read through the component instead of fetching JWKS over HTTP, enforces the canonical issuer, audience, algorithm, header, lifetime, token class, and scope lists before one live grant query, and returns a typed principal. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate review always passes the required token grant id to the live query.

Separated verified-token parsing from provider-owned live authority and rechecks component-owned persisted-session admission plus the current client, resource, compound link, consent, expiry, and scopes before every MCP request without assuming provider-owned row IDs. The 2026-09-15 extension requires renewable access to carry its original consent identity and rejects a replacement consent even when client, resource, and scopes match. The 2026-09-26 MCP pass collapses live access into one component query that denies duplicate rows and binds the consent id to the token grant id. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate review requires the grant id for every token, denies a disabled resource for already-issued tokens, and removes the exported OAuthLiveAccess type.
Rewrote the Convex JWT provider so issuer and JWKS authority resolve only from the validated Convex deployment site origin.

Compiled the component test registration helper against the exact packaged schema and modules, and added a test-only auth constructor that admits Better Auth test utilities only while both configured origins remain validated loopback URLs. The 2026-09-26 pass follows the factory-only composition path. The same pass adds signInAs, which creates a live user and session through the component adapter and returns a convex-test client with the library session-token claims.

Consolidated only the maintained trigger, relationship-aware write, auth-factory, guarded-consume, atomic-increment, and authenticated signing-key lifecycle component API types. The 2026-09-26 pass adds the admitted live-user type returned by the factory helpers and the internal claims-only session type used by admission.

Extracted the optional application-user trigger path into one explicitly derived and rebuildable projection helper whose validated indexed auth key is owned by the helper, cannot be overridden by consumer callbacks, uses a bounded lookup, fails closed on ambiguous survivors, and recreates a missing projection from the current canonical update snapshot.
Extracted the fixed RS256 JWT and encrypted signing-key policy into one shared runtime and build-time plugin constructor.

Original Better Convex extension of the rewritten component API seam; no upstream refresh implementation is copied. Admits renewal from live provider session, client, resource, link, and immutable consent rows; constrains child expiry and privileges to the original session and rotation parent; revokes only the consent bound to a rejected or revoked family. Admission and consent revocation read the (clientId, resourceId) and (clientId, userId) compound indexes. A stored row without a string bcnConsentId (issued by a 1.0.0 beta) is denied before any lookup, so beta refresh tokens never renew.

Original Better Convex extension of the rewritten provider integration seam; no upstream refresh implementation is copied. Uses the official Better Auth request context, APIError, and Basic-auth decoder to carry rotation-parent and presented-grant evidence for one request, bind the requesting client, emit retryable busy responses, and issue the immutable consent claim; Convex retains persistence authority. The 2026-09-27 release-candidate review issues the consent claim for every access token, not only renewable ones.

New 2026-09-26 MCP principal contract: a strict validator for the verified OAuth principal and requireMcpPrincipal, which rechecks shape, expiry, issuer, and resource, runs one live grant query bound to the consent id, then enforces the required scope.

New 2026-09-26 MCP OAuth profile: strictly validated options that pin PKCE public clients, consent, per-client resources, short-lived access tokens, session-bound renewal, hashed storage, denied client and resource management, and exact ChatGPT and Claude redirect presets.
New 2026-09-26 per-user OAuth connection helpers: bounded listing of a user's grants and revocation that deletes consent before refresh tokens so every live check and renewal fails first.
